items.question: Trong câu "In reality, the dev isn't being lazy or exaggerating.", từ "exaggerate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In reality, the dev isn't being lazy or exaggerating.", what does "exaggerate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put something off until later
to say you are unhappy about something
to make something seem bigger than it is
to keep away from a subject
items.explanation: exaggerate /ɪɡˈzædʒ.ə.reɪt/ (động từ): phóng đại, nói quá. Dạng V-ing "exaggerating" = đang nói quá; dev nói "không đơn giản" không phải vì phóng đại vấn đề.
items.explanationEn: exaggerate /ɪɡˈzædʒ.ə.reɪt/ (verb): to make something seem bigger than it is. Often used as "be exaggerating"; the dev saying "it's not that simple" is not overstating the problem.

items.question: Trong câu "In reality, the dev isn't being lazy or exaggerating.", từ "lazy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In reality, the dev isn't being lazy or exaggerating.", what does "lazy" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: unwilling to work or make an effort
items.explanation: lazy /ˈleɪ.zi/ (tính từ): lười biếng. "Be lazy" = lười; câu này nhấn mạnh dev không lười mà thấy những rủi ro BA chưa thấy.
items.explanationEn: lazy /ˈleɪ.zi/ (adjective): unwilling to work or make an effort. "Be lazy" means not wanting to make an effort; the dev is not lazy but sees risks the BA has not seen.

items.question: Trong câu "In reality, the dev isn't being lazy or exaggerating.", từ "in reality" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In reality, the dev isn't being lazy or exaggerating.", what does "in reality" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: actually, contrary to how it seems
items.explanation: in reality /ɪn riˈæl.ə.ti/ (cụm từ): thực ra, trên thực tế. "In reality" dùng để đối lập với điều người ta tưởng; thường đứng đầu câu, theo sau là dấu phẩy.
items.explanationEn: in reality /ɪn riˈæl.ə.ti/ (phrase): actually, contrary to how it seems. "In reality" contrasts what is true with what people assume; it usually opens a sentence, followed by a comma.

items.question: Trong câu "This "small" feature requires changes in 5 different places because the code is coupled", từ "coupled" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This "small" feature requires changes in 5 different places because the code is coupled", what does "coupled" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: coupled /ˈkʌp.əld/ (tính từ): phụ thuộc chặt vào nhau. "Tightly coupled code" = mã phụ thuộc chặt, sửa một chỗ phải sửa nhiều chỗ; trái nghĩa: loosely coupled.
items.explanationEn: coupled /ˈkʌp.əld/ (adjective): tightly dependent on other parts. "Tightly coupled code" means changing one part forces changes elsewhere; the opposite is "loosely coupled".

items.question: Trong câu "A shortcut was taken earlier, and now every new thing has to work around it", từ "work around" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A shortcut was taken earlier, and now every new thing has to work around it", what does "work around" (phrase) mean?
options: tìm cách lách qua, né vấn đề
optionsEn: to find a way past a problem without fixing it
to walk in a circle around
items.explanation: work around /wɜːk əˈraʊnd/ (cụm từ): tìm cách lách qua, né vấn đề. "Work around a problem" = tìm cách xoay xở mà không sửa gốc; danh từ: a workaround (giải pháp tạm).
items.explanationEn: work around /wɜːk əˈraʊnd/ (phrase): to find a way past a problem without fixing it. "Work around a problem" means avoiding it without fixing the cause; the noun is "a workaround".

items.question: Trong câu "Doing it properly takes 3 days; taking a shortcut takes 2 hours but incurs debt", từ "incur" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Doing it properly takes 3 days; taking a shortcut takes 2 hours but incurs debt", what does "incur" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to bring something unpleasant on yourself
items.explanation: incur /ɪnˈkɜːr/ (động từ): gánh chịu, phát sinh (chi phí). Hay đi với chi phí, nợ, rủi ro: incur costs, incur debt, incur a penalty.
items.explanationEn: incur /ɪnˈkɜːr/ (verb): to bring something unpleasant on yourself. Collocates with costs, debt and risks: incur costs, incur debt, incur a penalty.

items.question: Trong câu "Doing it properly takes 3 days; taking a shortcut takes 2 hours but incurs debt", từ "properly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Doing it properly takes 3 days; taking a shortcut takes 2 hours but incurs debt", what does "properly" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách đúng đắn, bài bản
items.explanation: properly /ˈprɒp.əl.i/ (trạng từ): một cách đúng đắn, bài bản. "Do it properly" = làm cho bài bản; đối lập với "take a shortcut" (đi đường tắt).
items.explanationEn: properly /ˈprɒp.əl.i/ (adverb): correctly, in the right way. "Do it properly" means doing it the right way, as opposed to taking a shortcut.

items.question: Trong câu "Technical Debt is a metaphor borrowed from financial debt: when you borrow money to do something faster, you have to pay interest later.", từ "metaphor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Technical Debt is a metaphor borrowed from financial debt: when you borrow money to do something faster, you have to pay interest later.", what does "metaphor" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a comparison that describes one thing as another
items.explanation: metaphor /ˈmet.ə.fɔːr/ (danh từ): phép ẩn dụ. "A metaphor borrowed from..." = hình ảnh ẩn dụ mượn từ lĩnh vực khác; "technical debt" mượn từ tài chính.
items.explanationEn: metaphor /ˈmet.ə.fɔːr/ (noun): a comparison that describes one thing as another. "A metaphor borrowed from..." means an image taken from another field; "technical debt" comes from finance.

items.question: Trong câu "Technical Debt is a metaphor borrowed from financial debt: when you borrow money to do something faster, you have to pay interest later.", từ "interest" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Technical Debt is a metaphor borrowed from financial debt: when you borrow money to do something faster, you have to pay interest later.", what does "interest" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a feeling of wanting to know more
extra money paid on a loan
items.explanation: interest /ˈɪn.trəst/ (danh từ): tiền lãi. "Pay interest" = trả lãi; nghĩa khác của interest là "sự quan tâm" (show interest in).
items.explanationEn: interest /ˈɪn.trəst/ (noun): extra money paid on a loan. "Pay interest" means paying extra on borrowed money; another sense is curiosity, as in "show interest in".

items.question: Trong câu "Interest: every subsequent time you want to change that code, it takes more time", từ "subsequent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Interest: every subsequent time you want to change that code, it takes more time", what does "subsequent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: subsequent /ˈsʌb.sɪ.kwənt/ (tính từ): tiếp theo, sau đó. "Every subsequent time" = mỗi lần sau đó; trạng từ: subsequently (sau đó).
items.explanationEn: subsequent /ˈsʌb.sɪ.kwənt/ (adjective): coming after something else. "Every subsequent time" means each later time; the adverb is "subsequently".

items.question: Trong câu "Default: the system becomes too hard to maintain, bugs pile up, and devs are afraid to touch anything", từ "default" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Default: the system becomes too hard to maintain, bugs pile up, and devs are afraid to touch anything", what does "default" (noun) mean?
options: sự vỡ nợ, mất khả năng trả nợ
optionsEn: a value used when none is chosen
failure to pay back a debt
items.explanation: default /dɪˈfɔːlt/ (danh từ): sự vỡ nợ, mất khả năng trả nợ. Trong ẩn dụ tài chính, "default" = vỡ nợ; trong IT thường gặp nghĩa khác là "giá trị mặc định".
items.explanationEn: default /dɪˈfɔːlt/ (noun): failure to pay back a debt. In the finance metaphor "default" means failing to repay; in IT it more often means a preset value.

items.question: Trong câu "Default: the system becomes too hard to maintain, bugs pile up, and devs are afraid to touch anything", từ "pile up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Default: the system becomes too hard to maintain, bugs pile up, and devs are afraid to touch anything", what does "pile up" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to build up into a large amount
items.explanation: pile up /paɪl ʌp/ (cụm từ): chồng chất, dồn đống. Hay dùng với việc, lỗi, nợ: work piles up, bugs pile up.
items.explanationEn: pile up /paɪl ʌp/ (phrase): to build up into a large amount. Used with work, bugs or debts that keep accumulating: "work piles up", "bugs pile up".

items.question: Trong câu "Sometimes borrowing intentionally is the right call.", từ "intentionally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sometimes borrowing intentionally is the right call.", what does "intentionally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: intentionally /ɪnˈten.ʃən.əl.i/ (trạng từ): một cách có chủ ý. "Borrow intentionally" = chủ động vay nợ kỹ thuật khi biết rõ; trái nghĩa: accidentally.
items.explanationEn: intentionally /ɪnˈten.ʃən.əl.i/ (adverb): on purpose, deliberately. "Borrow intentionally" means taking on debt knowingly; the opposite is "accidentally".

items.question: Trong câu "The user base is still small (<1000 people), so performance isn't yet an issue", từ "issue" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The user base is still small (<1000 people), so performance isn't yet an issue", what does "issue" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: issue /ˈɪʃ.uː/ (danh từ): vấn đề (cần lo). "Not an issue (yet)" = chưa phải là vấn đề; nghĩa khác: một số báo/tạp chí (the latest issue).
items.explanationEn: issue /ˈɪʃ.uː/ (noun): a problem to deal with. "Not an issue (yet)" means not a problem so far; another sense is one edition of a magazine.

items.question: Trong câu "Stakeholders need to see it to confirm the direction", từ "stakeholder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stakeholders need to see it to confirm the direction", what does "stakeholder" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person with an interest in a project
items.explanation: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkˌhəʊl.dər/ (danh từ): bên liên quan (có quyền lợi). Stakeholders gồm khách hàng, quản lý, nhà đầu tư... những người bị ảnh hưởng hoặc có quyền quyết định.
items.explanationEn: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkˌhəʊl.dər/ (noun): a person with an interest in a project. Stakeholders include clients, managers and investors: anyone affected by or deciding on the project.

items.question: Trong câu "Stakeholders need to see it to confirm the direction", từ "confirm" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stakeholders need to see it to confirm the direction", what does "confirm" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to state that something is correct
items.explanation: confirm /kənˈfɜːm/ (động từ): xác nhận. "Confirm the direction" = xác nhận hướng đi đúng; danh từ: confirmation.
items.explanationEn: confirm /kənˈfɜːm/ (verb): to state that something is correct. "Confirm the direction" means agreeing the approach is right; the noun is "confirmation".

items.question: Trong câu "This is a core feature that's definitely needed", từ "core" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is a core feature that's definitely needed", what does "core" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: core /kɔːr/ (tính từ): cốt lõi, chủ chốt. "Core feature" = tính năng cốt lõi; danh từ "core" còn có nghĩa lõi (của quả, CPU core).
items.explanationEn: core /kɔːr/ (adjective): central and most important. "Core feature" means a central feature; as a noun "core" also means the centre of a fruit or a CPU core.

items.question: Trong câu "This is a core feature that's definitely needed", từ "definitely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is a core feature that's definitely needed", what does "definitely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: definitely /ˈdef.ɪ.nət.li/ (trạng từ): chắc chắn. "Definitely needed" = chắc chắn cần; mạnh hơn "probably" (có lẽ).
items.explanationEn: definitely /ˈdef.ɪ.nət.li/ (adverb): without any doubt. "Definitely needed" means needed for sure; it is stronger than "probably".

items.question: Trong câu "The data is already large, so performance will be an issue immediately", từ "immediately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The data is already large, so performance will be an issue immediately", what does "immediately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: immediately /ɪˈmiː.di.ət.li/ (trạng từ): ngay lập tức. "Be an issue immediately" = thành vấn đề ngay; tính từ: immediate (tức thì).
items.explanationEn: immediately /ɪˈmiː.di.ət.li/ (adverb): at once, right away. "Be an issue immediately" means becoming a problem right away; the adjective is "immediate".

items.question: Trong câu "This is usually over-engineering, increasing complexity without immediate value.", từ "complexity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is usually over-engineering, increasing complexity without immediate value.", what does "complexity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: complexity /kəmˈplek.sə.ti/ (danh từ): độ phức tạp. "Increase complexity" = làm tăng độ phức tạp; tính từ: complex.
items.explanationEn: complexity /kəmˈplek.sə.ti/ (noun): the state of being complicated. "Increase complexity" means making things more complicated; the adjective is "complex".

items.question: Trong câu "This is usually over-engineering, increasing complexity without immediate value.", từ "over-engineering" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is usually over-engineering, increasing complexity without immediate value.", what does "over-engineering" (noun) mean?
options: thiết kế thiếu, chưa đủ dùng
thiết kế thừa, làm phức tạp quá mức cần
bảo trì hệ thống định kỳ
optionsEn: building more than is actually needed
taking apart a product to study it
items.explanation: over-engineering /ˌəʊ.vər.en.dʒɪˈnɪə.rɪŋ/ (danh từ): thiết kế thừa, làm phức tạp quá mức cần. Over-engineering đi ngược nguyên tắc YAGNI: xây cho "có thể cần sau này".
items.explanationEn: over-engineering /ˌəʊ.vər.en.dʒɪˈnɪə.rɪŋ/ (noun): building more than is actually needed. Over-engineering goes against YAGNI: building for what "might be needed later".

items.question: Trong câu "How much does it cost? Who approves the budget?", từ "approve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How much does it cost? Who approves the budget?", what does "approve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: approve /əˈpruːv/ (động từ): phê duyệt. "Approve the budget" = phê duyệt ngân sách; danh từ: approval.
items.explanationEn: approve /əˈpruːv/ (verb): to officially accept. "Approve the budget" means officially agreeing to it; the noun is "approval".

items.question: Trong câu "How much does it cost? Who approves the budget?", từ "budget" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How much does it cost? Who approves the budget?", what does "budget" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: budget /ˈbʌdʒ.ɪt/ (danh từ): ngân sách. Cụm hay gặp: approve the budget, over budget (vượt ngân sách), within budget.
items.explanationEn: budget /ˈbʌdʒ.ɪt/ (noun): money planned for a purpose. Common phrases: approve the budget, over budget, within budget.

items.question: Trong câu "Is there an SLA (uptime guarantee)?", từ "guarantee" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is there an SLA (uptime guarantee)?", what does "guarantee" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a firm promise that something will happen
items.explanation: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (danh từ): sự cam kết, bảo đảm. "Uptime guarantee" = cam kết thời gian hoạt động (vd 99.9%); cũng là động từ: guarantee.
items.explanationEn: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (noun): a firm promise that something will happen. "Uptime guarantee" is a promise of availability, e.g. 99.9%; "guarantee" is also a verb.

items.question: Trong câu "If the third-party service goes down, how is our system affected?", từ "affect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the third-party service goes down, how is our system affected?", what does "affect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: affect /əˈfekt/ (động từ): ảnh hưởng, tác động. Động từ "affect" khác danh từ "effect"; "be affected" = bị ảnh hưởng.
items.explanationEn: affect /əˈfekt/ (verb): to have an influence on. Do not confuse the verb "affect" with the noun "effect"; "be affected" means being influenced.

items.question: Trong câu "If the third-party service goes down, how is our system affected?", từ "go down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the third-party service goes down, how is our system affected?", what does "go down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: go down /ɡəʊ daʊn/ (cụm từ): ngừng hoạt động, sập. "The service goes down" = dịch vụ sập; nghĩa khác: giảm (prices go down).
items.explanationEn: go down /ɡəʊ daʊn/ (phrase): to stop working. "The service goes down" means it stops working; it can also mean decrease, as in "prices go down".

items.question: Trong câu "Is data being sent externally? Are there any compliance concerns?", từ "externally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is data being sent externally? Are there any compliance concerns?", what does "externally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: externally /ɪkˈstɜː.nəl.i/ (trạng từ): ra bên ngoài. "Send data externally" = gửi dữ liệu ra ngoài tổ chức; trái nghĩa: internally.
items.explanationEn: externally /ɪkˈstɜː.nəl.i/ (adverb): to the outside. "Send data externally" means outside the organization; the opposite is "internally".

items.question: Trong câu "Is data being sent externally? Are there any compliance concerns?", từ "compliance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is data being sent externally? Are there any compliance concerns?", what does "compliance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (danh từ): sự tuân thủ (quy định). "Compliance concerns" = lo ngại về tuân thủ quy định (luật dữ liệu, bảo mật); động từ: comply with.
items.explanationEn: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (noun): following rules or laws. "Compliance concerns" are worries about meeting rules or laws; the verb is "comply with".

items.question: Trong câu "Is data being sent externally? Are there any compliance concerns?", từ "concern" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is data being sent externally? Are there any compliance concerns?", what does "concern" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: concern /kənˈsɜːn/ (danh từ): mối lo ngại. "Raise a concern" = nêu lo ngại; nghĩa khác (trang trọng): một doanh nghiệp (a going concern).
items.explanationEn: concern /kənˈsɜːn/ (noun): a worry about something. "Raise a concern" means voicing a worry; a formal sense is a business, as in "a going concern".

items.question: Trong câu "MVP (Minimum Viable Product) doesn't mean building something bad.", từ "viable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "MVP (Minimum Viable Product) doesn't mean building something bad.", what does "viable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: viable /ˈvaɪ.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): khả thi, dùng được. "Minimum Viable Product" = sản phẩm tối thiểu nhưng vẫn dùng được; "a viable option" = phương án khả thi.
items.explanationEn: viable /ˈvaɪ.ə.bəl/ (adjective): able to work successfully. "Minimum Viable Product" is the smallest product that still works; "a viable option" is a workable choice.

items.question: Trong câu "Validate the most important assumption", từ "assumption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Validate the most important assumption", what does "assumption" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (danh từ): giả định. "Validate an assumption" = kiểm chứng giả định; động từ: assume.
items.explanationEn: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (noun): something believed true without proof. "Validate an assumption" means checking whether a belief is true; the verb is "assume".

items.question: Trong câu "Ship it to real users", từ "ship" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ship it to real users", what does "ship" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to release a product to users
items.explanation: ship /ʃɪp/ (động từ): phát hành, đưa ra (sản phẩm). Trong phần mềm, "ship a feature" = phát hành cho người dùng; nghĩa gốc là vận chuyển hàng.
items.explanationEn: ship /ʃɪp/ (verb): to release a product to users. In software, "ship a feature" means releasing it; the original sense is sending goods by sea.

items.question: Trong câu "Gather feedback before investing further", từ "gather" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Gather feedback before investing further", what does "gather" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: gather /ˈɡæð.ər/ (động từ): thu thập. "Gather feedback/requirements" = thu thập phản hồi/yêu cầu; rất hay gặp trong công việc BA.
items.explanationEn: gather /ˈɡæð.ər/ (verb): to collect from different places. "Gather feedback" or "gather requirements" means collecting them; very common in BA work.

items.question: Trong câu "Gather feedback before investing further", từ "further" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Gather feedback before investing further", what does "further" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: further /ˈfɜː.ðər/ (trạng từ): thêm nữa, xa hơn. "Invest further" = đầu tư thêm; "further" còn là tính từ: further information (thông tin thêm).
items.explanationEn: further /ˈfɜː.ðər/ (adverb): more, to a greater degree. "Invest further" means investing more; as an adjective: "further information".

items.question: Trong câu "The team knows it's borrowing and has a plan to repay", từ "repay" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The team knows it's borrowing and has a plan to repay", what does "repay" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: repay /rɪˈpeɪ/ (động từ): trả lại (nợ). "Repay a debt" = trả nợ; danh từ: repayment. Nợ kỹ thuật cũng cần kế hoạch trả.
items.explanationEn: repay /rɪˈpeɪ/ (verb): to pay back money owed. "Repay a debt" means paying it back; the noun is "repayment". Technical debt needs a repayment plan too.

items.question: Trong câu "Adding debt on top of old debt = compound interest", từ "compound" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Adding debt on top of old debt = compound interest", what does "compound" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: calculated on the amount plus earlier interest
items.explanation: compound /ˈkɒm.paʊnd/ (tính từ): kép, cộng dồn. "Compound interest" = lãi kép (lãi chồng lên lãi); danh từ "compound" còn nghĩa là hợp chất.
items.explanationEn: compound /ˈkɒm.paʊnd/ (adjective): calculated on the amount plus earlier interest. "Compound interest" is interest on interest; as a noun "compound" also means a chemical mixture.

items.question: Trong câu "A "temporary" shortcut that lasts 3 years", từ "temporary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A "temporary" shortcut that lasts 3 years", what does "temporary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: temporary /ˈtem.pər.ər.i/ (tính từ): tạm thời. Ngoặc kép quanh "temporary" mang ý mỉa mai: tạm thời nhưng tồn tại 3 năm; trái nghĩa: permanent.
items.explanationEn: temporary /ˈtem.pər.ər.i/ (adjective): lasting only a short time. The quotes around "temporary" are ironic: it lasted 3 years. The opposite is "permanent".

items.question: Trong câu "No one tracks and repays it", từ "track" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No one tracks and repays it", what does "track" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to follow and record over time
items.explanation: track /træk/ (động từ): theo dõi. "Track debt/progress" = theo dõi nợ/tiến độ; "keep track of" = nắm được, theo dõi. Danh từ "track" = đường ray.
items.explanationEn: track /træk/ (verb): to follow and record over time. "Track debt" means following it over time; see also "keep track of". As a noun, "track" is a rail line.

items.question: Trong câu "This part is really old, nobody dares to touch it", từ "dare" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This part is really old, nobody dares to touch it", what does "dare" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to be brave enough to do
to make an effort to do
items.explanation: dare /deər/ (động từ): dám. "Dare to do something" = dám làm gì; ở đây dev sợ đụng vào mã cũ vì dễ gây lỗi.
items.explanationEn: dare /deər/ (verb): to be brave enough to do. "Dare to do something" means being brave enough; here devs fear touching old code.

items.question: Trong câu "The estimate is high because we need to refactor before building the new feature", từ "estimate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The estimate is high because we need to refactor before building the new feature", what does "estimate" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a rough calculation of effort or time
items.explanation: estimate /ˈes.tɪ.mət/ (danh từ): ước tính (thời gian, công sức). Danh từ /-mət/, động từ /-meɪt/; "the estimate is high" = ước tính công sức cao.
items.explanationEn: estimate /ˈes.tɪ.mət/ (noun): a rough calculation of effort or time. The noun ends in /-mət/, the verb in /-meɪt/; "the estimate is high" means much effort is expected.

items.question: Trong câu "Sprint velocity gradually declines across sprints", từ "velocity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sprint velocity gradually declines across sprints", what does "velocity" (noun) mean?
options: tốc độ làm việc của nhóm
optionsEn: work a team finishes per sprint
items.explanation: velocity /vəˈlɒs.ə.ti/ (danh từ): tốc độ làm việc của nhóm. Trong Agile, "velocity" = lượng story point team làm xong mỗi sprint; nghĩa vật lý là vận tốc.
items.explanationEn: velocity /vəˈlɒs.ə.ti/ (noun): work a team finishes per sprint. In Agile, "velocity" is story points completed per sprint; in physics it is speed with direction.

items.question: Trong câu "Sprint velocity gradually declines across sprints", từ "gradually" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sprint velocity gradually declines across sprints", what does "gradually" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: gradually /ˈɡrædʒ.u.ə.li/ (trạng từ): dần dần. "Gradually decline" = giảm dần; trái nghĩa: suddenly (đột ngột).
items.explanationEn: gradually /ˈɡrædʒ.u.ə.li/ (adverb): slowly over time. "Gradually decline" means falling little by little; the opposite is "suddenly".

items.question: Trong câu "Sprint velocity gradually declines across sprints", từ "decline" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sprint velocity gradually declines across sprints", what does "decline" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: decline /dɪˈklaɪn/ (động từ): giảm sút. Nghĩa ở đây là giảm; nghĩa khác: từ chối lịch sự (decline an invitation).
items.explanationEn: decline /dɪˈklaɪn/ (verb): to become less. Here it means to decrease; another sense is to refuse politely, as in "decline an invitation".

items.question: Trong câu "Regression bugs: fix one thing here, break something else there", từ "regression" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Regression bugs: fix one thing here, break something else there", what does "regression" (noun) mean?
options: lỗi tái phát ở phần cũ
optionsEn: a fault returning in old parts
items.explanation: regression /rɪˈɡreʃ.ən/ (danh từ): lỗi tái phát ở phần cũ. "Regression bug" = lỗi xuất hiện ở chức năng cũ sau khi sửa đổi; "regression testing" = kiểm thử hồi quy.
items.explanationEn: regression /rɪˈɡreʃ.ən/ (noun): a fault returning in old parts. A "regression bug" breaks something that used to work; "regression testing" checks for them.

items.question: Trong câu "No automated tests → no one dares to refactor", từ "automated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No automated tests → no one dares to refactor", what does "automated" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: done by machines without human effort
items.explanation: automated /ˈɔː.tə.meɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): tự động hóa. "Automated tests" = kiểm thử tự động; thiếu chúng thì không ai dám refactor.
items.explanationEn: automated /ˈɔː.tə.meɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): done by machines without human effort. "Automated tests" run without manual effort; without them nobody dares to refactor.

items.question: Trong câu "Deployments take hours and carry high risk", từ "carry" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deployments take hours and carry high risk", what does "carry" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to lift and move by hand
items.explanation: carry /ˈkær.i/ (động từ): mang theo, kèm theo (rủi ro). "Carry (a) risk" = kèm rủi ro; nghĩa gốc là mang, vác đồ vật.
items.explanationEn: carry /ˈkær.i/ (verb): to involve or include. "Carry risk" means involving risk; the basic sense is holding and moving objects.

items.question: Trong câu "When a BA realizes this:", từ "realize" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a BA realizes this:", what does "realize" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: realize /ˈrɪə.laɪz/ (động từ): nhận ra. "Realize (that)..." = nhận ra; nghĩa khác: hiện thực hóa (realize a goal).
items.explanationEn: realize /ˈrɪə.laɪz/ (verb): to become aware of. "Realize that..." means becoming aware; another sense is to achieve, as in "realize a goal".

items.question: Trong câu "Don't push more feature pressure", từ "pressure" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Don't push more feature pressure", what does "pressure" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: force on a surface in physics
items.explanation: pressure /ˈpreʃ.ər/ (danh từ): áp lực. "Push pressure" = dồn thêm áp lực; "under pressure" = chịu áp lực.
items.explanationEn: pressure /ˈpreʃ.ər/ (noun): a demand that causes stress. "Push more pressure" means adding stress; "under pressure" means stressed by demands.

items.question: Trong câu "Can we dedicate 20% of the sprint's capacity to refactoring?", từ "dedicate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Can we dedicate 20% of the sprint's capacity to refactoring?", what does "dedicate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to set aside for one purpose
items.explanation: dedicate /ˈded.ɪ.keɪt/ (động từ): dành riêng (cho việc gì). Cấu trúc "dedicate X to Y" = dành X cho Y; tính từ: dedicated (chuyên dụng, tận tâm).
items.explanationEn: dedicate /ˈded.ɪ.keɪt/ (verb): to set aside for one purpose. Pattern: "dedicate X to Y"; the adjective "dedicated" means reserved or committed.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA needs to clarify with stakeholders: what is this project prioritizing?", từ "clarify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA needs to clarify with stakeholders: what is this project prioritizing?", what does "clarify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: clarify /ˈklær.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): làm rõ. "Clarify with someone" = làm rõ với ai; danh từ: clarification.
items.explanationEn: clarify /ˈklær.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to make clear. "Clarify with someone" means making something clear together; the noun is "clarification".

items.question: Trong câu "The BA needs to clarify with stakeholders: what is this project prioritizing?", từ "prioritize" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA needs to clarify with stakeholders: what is this project prioritizing?", what does "prioritize" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prioritize /praɪˈɒr.ɪ.taɪz/ (động từ): ưu tiên. "Prioritize X over Y" = ưu tiên X hơn Y; danh từ: priority.
items.explanationEn: prioritize /praɪˈɒr.ɪ.taɪz/ (verb): to treat as most important. "Prioritize X over Y" means putting X first; the noun is "priority".

items.question: Trong câu "If you don't align on this from the start → stakeholders expect all 3 → the team burns out.", từ "align" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you don't align on this from the start → stakeholders expect all 3 → the team burns out.", what does "align" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to line up text or objects
items.explanation: align /əˈlaɪn/ (động từ): thống nhất (quan điểm). "Align on something" = thống nhất về điều gì; nghĩa khác trong CSS: căn lề (align text).
items.explanationEn: align /əˈlaɪn/ (verb): to reach agreement. "Align on something" means agreeing on it; in CSS it means positioning, as in "align text".

items.question: Trong câu "If you don't align on this from the start → stakeholders expect all 3 → the team burns out.", từ "expect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you don't align on this from the start → stakeholders expect all 3 → the team burns out.", what does "expect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expect /ɪkˈspekt/ (động từ): kỳ vọng, trông đợi. Danh từ: expectation; "manage expectations" = quản lý kỳ vọng, việc quan trọng của BA.
items.explanationEn: expect /ɪkˈspekt/ (verb): to think something will happen. The noun is "expectation"; "manage expectations" is a key BA skill.

items.question: Trong câu "If you don't align on this from the start → stakeholders expect all 3 → the team burns out.", từ "burn out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you don't align on this from the start → stakeholders expect all 3 → the team burns out.", what does "burn out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: burn out /bɜːn aʊt/ (cụm từ): kiệt sức. "The team burns out" = team kiệt sức do áp lực kéo dài; danh từ: burnout.
items.explanationEn: burn out /bɜːn aʊt/ (phrase): to become exhausted from overwork. "The team burns out" means exhaustion from long pressure; the noun is "burnout".

items.question: Trong câu "MVP, prototype — many bugs, not scalable", từ "scalable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "MVP, prototype — many bugs, not scalable", what does "scalable" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: able to grow with more load
items.explanation: scalable /ˈskeɪ.lə.bəl/ (tính từ): mở rộng được (khi tải tăng). "Scalable system" = hệ thống mở rộng tốt khi người dùng tăng; danh từ: scalability.
items.explanationEn: scalable /ˈskeɪ.lə.bəl/ (adjective): able to grow with more load. A "scalable system" copes with more users; the noun is "scalability".

items.question: Trong câu "MVP, prototype — many bugs, not scalable", từ "prototype" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "MVP, prototype — many bugs, not scalable", what does "prototype" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: prototype /ˈprəʊ.tə.taɪp/ (danh từ): bản mẫu thử. Prototype dùng để thử ý tưởng nhanh, chưa phải sản phẩm hoàn chỉnh.
items.explanationEn: prototype /ˈprəʊ.tə.taɪp/ (noun): an early test version. A prototype tests an idea quickly; it is not a finished product.

items.question: Trong câu "Needs many skilled devs, high cost", từ "skilled" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Needs many skilled devs, high cost", what does "skilled" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: skilled /skɪld/ (tính từ): lành nghề, giỏi. "Skilled devs" = dev giỏi, có kinh nghiệm; muốn nhanh và tốt thì tốn chi phí.
items.explanationEn: skilled /skɪld/ (adjective): having ability and experience. "Skilled devs" are experienced developers; fast and good means expensive.

items.question: Trong câu "How confident (%) are you about the estimate?", từ "confident" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How confident (%) are you about the estimate?", what does "confident" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: confident /ˈkɒn.fɪ.dənt/ (tính từ): tin chắc, tự tin. "Confident about/in" = tin chắc vào; đừng nhầm với "confidential" (bí mật).
items.explanationEn: confident /ˈkɒn.fɪ.dənt/ (adjective): feeling sure about something. "Confident about" means sure of; do not confuse it with "confidential" (secret).

items.question: Trong câu "What % of the user base does this feature serve?", từ "serve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What % of the user base does this feature serve?", what does "serve" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to bring food to a table
items.explanation: serve /sɜːv/ (động từ): phục vụ, đáp ứng. "A feature serves users" = tính năng đáp ứng người dùng; nghĩa khác: dọn món (serve food).
items.explanationEn: serve /sɜːv/ (verb): to meet the needs of. "A feature serves users" means meeting their needs; another sense is "serve food".

items.question: Trong câu "is the workaround acceptable?", từ "workaround" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "is the workaround acceptable?", what does "workaround" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a temporary way around a problem
items.explanation: workaround /ˈwɜːk.ə.raʊnd/ (danh từ): giải pháp tạm, cách lách. Nếu không có tính năng, người dùng dùng cách lách nào? Động từ tương ứng: work around.
items.explanationEn: workaround /ˈwɜːk.ə.raʊnd/ (noun): a temporary way around a problem. If the feature did not exist, what would users do instead? The related verb is "work around".

items.question: Trong câu "is the workaround acceptable?", từ "acceptable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "is the workaround acceptable?", what does "acceptable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: acceptable /əkˈsep.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): chấp nhận được. "Acceptable" = đủ tốt để chấp nhận, không nhất thiết hoàn hảo; trái nghĩa: unacceptable.
items.explanationEn: acceptable /əkˈsep.tə.bəl/ (adjective): good enough to be allowed. "Acceptable" means good enough, not necessarily perfect; the opposite is "unacceptable".

items.question: Trong câu "If we take a shortcut this sprint and refactor next sprint, what's the specific refactoring plan?", từ "specific" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If we take a shortcut this sprint and refactor next sprint, what's the specific refactoring plan?", what does "specific" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: specific /spəˈsɪf.ɪk/ (tính từ): cụ thể, rõ ràng. "A specific plan" = kế hoạch cụ thể; trạng từ: specifically.
items.explanationEn: specific /spəˈsɪf.ɪk/ (adjective): clearly defined, detailed. "A specific plan" is a detailed one; the adverb is "specifically".

items.question: Trong câu "The product launches in 3 weeks.", từ "launch" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The product launches in 3 weeks.", what does "launch" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to send a rocket into the air
to be released to the public
items.explanation: launch /lɔːntʃ/ (động từ): ra mắt. "The product launches" = sản phẩm ra mắt; danh từ: a launch; nghĩa khác: phóng tàu vũ trụ.
items.explanationEn: launch /lɔːntʃ/ (verb): to be released to the public. "The product launches" means it is released; the noun is "a launch"; it also means sending up a rocket.

items.question: Trong câu "Stakeholders want to add a "related product recommendations" feature (recommendation).", từ "related" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stakeholders want to add a "related product recommendations" feature (recommendation).", what does "related" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: related /rɪˈleɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): liên quan. "Related products" = sản phẩm liên quan; "be related to" = liên quan đến; nghĩa khác: có họ hàng.
items.explanationEn: related /rɪˈleɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): connected in some way. "Related products" are connected products; "related" can also mean being in the same family.

items.question: Trong câu "Stakeholders want to add a "related product recommendations" feature (recommendation).", từ "recommendation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stakeholders want to add a "related product recommendations" feature (recommendation).", what does "recommendation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: recommendation /ˌrek.ə.menˈdeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự gợi ý, đề xuất. Động từ: recommend; "recommendation engine" = hệ thống gợi ý sản phẩm.
items.explanationEn: recommendation /ˌrek.ə.menˈdeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a suggestion of something suitable. The verb is "recommend"; a "recommendation engine" suggests products.

items.question: Trong câu "This sprint: recommend by the same category (3 days).", từ "category" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This sprint: recommend by the same category (3 days).", what does "category" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: category /ˈkæt.ə.ɡər.i/ (danh từ): danh mục, loại. "Same category" = cùng danh mục; động từ: categorize (phân loại).
items.explanationEn: category /ˈkæt.ə.ɡər.i/ (noun): a group of similar things. "Same category" means the same group; the verb is "categorize".

items.question: Trong câu "Log it in the backlog for Sprint 5: implement collaborative filtering once we have enough data from the first 2 months of launch.", từ "log" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Log it in the backlog for Sprint 5: implement collaborative filtering once we have enough data from the first 2 months of launch.", what does "log" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: log /lɒɡ/ (động từ): ghi lại (vào sổ, hệ thống). "Log it in the backlog" = ghi vào backlog; "log in" (có "in" sau) mới là đăng nhập.
items.explanationEn: log /lɒɡ/ (verb): to officially record. "Log it in the backlog" means recording it; "log in" as a phrasal verb means signing in.

items.question: Trong câu "Log it in the backlog for Sprint 5: implement collaborative filtering once we have enough data from the first 2 months of launch.", từ "implement" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Log it in the backlog for Sprint 5: implement collaborative filtering once we have enough data from the first 2 months of launch.", what does "implement" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: implement /ˈɪm.plɪ.ment/ (động từ): triển khai, hiện thực hóa. "Implement a feature" = hiện thực tính năng; danh từ: implementation.
items.explanationEn: implement /ˈɪm.plɪ.ment/ (verb): to put into action. "Implement a feature" means building it; the noun is "implementation".

items.question: Trong câu "Log it in the backlog for Sprint 5: implement collaborative filtering once we have enough data from the first 2 months of launch.", từ "collaborative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Log it in the backlog for Sprint 5: implement collaborative filtering once we have enough data from the first 2 months of launch.", what does "collaborative" (adjective) mean?
options: dựa trên cộng tác, nhiều người
items.explanation: collaborative /kəˈlæb.ər.ə.tɪv/ (tính từ): dựa trên cộng tác, nhiều người. "Collaborative filtering" = lọc cộng tác: gợi ý dựa trên hành vi của nhiều người dùng tương tự.
items.explanationEn: collaborative /kəˈlæb.ər.ə.tɪv/ (adjective): involving many people working together. "Collaborative filtering" recommends items based on the behaviour of many similar users.

items.question: Trong câu "This is conscious debt, not accidental technical debt.", từ "conscious" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is conscious debt, not accidental technical debt.", what does "conscious" (adjective) mean?
options: có ý thức, có chủ đích
items.explanation: conscious /ˈkɒn.ʃəs/ (tính từ): có ý thức, có chủ đích. "Conscious debt" = nợ vay có chủ đích; nghĩa khác: tỉnh táo (the patient is conscious).
items.explanationEn: conscious /ˈkɒn.ʃəs/ (adjective): done with full awareness. "Conscious debt" is taken knowingly; another sense is being awake, as in "the patient is conscious".

items.question: Trong câu "This is conscious debt, not accidental technical debt.", từ "accidental" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is conscious debt, not accidental technical debt.", what does "accidental" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: accidental /ˌæk.sɪˈden.təl/ (tính từ): vô tình, ngoài ý muốn. "Accidental debt" = nợ phát sinh vô tình, không ai biết; trái nghĩa: intentional/conscious.
items.explanationEn: accidental /ˌæk.sɪˈden.təl/ (adjective): happening by chance. "Accidental debt" builds up without anyone noticing; the opposite is "intentional" or "conscious".

items.question: Trong câu "There's immediate business value (some recommendation > nothing)", từ "immediate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There's immediate business value (some recommendation > nothing)", what does "immediate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: immediate /ɪˈmiː.di.ət/ (tính từ): tức thì, ngay lập tức. "Immediate value" = giá trị có ngay; trạng từ: immediately.
items.explanationEn: immediate /ɪˈmiː.di.ət/ (adjective): happening right now. "Immediate value" is value you get right away; the adverb is "immediately".

items.question: Trong câu "No launch delay", từ "delay" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No launch delay", what does "delay" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a time when something is late
items.explanation: delay /dɪˈleɪ/ (danh từ): sự chậm trễ. "Launch delay" = chậm ra mắt; cũng là động từ: delay the launch.
items.explanationEn: delay /dɪˈleɪ/ (noun): a time when something is late. "Launch delay" means launching later than planned; also a verb: "delay the launch".

items.question: Trong câu "The BA should proactively maintain a "debt ledger":", từ "proactively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA should proactively maintain a "debt ledger":", what does "proactively" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: proactively /prəʊˈæk.tɪv.li/ (trạng từ): một cách chủ động. "Proactively" = chủ động làm trước khi có vấn đề; trái nghĩa: reactively.
items.explanationEn: proactively /prəʊˈæk.tɪv.li/ (adverb): by acting before being asked. "Proactively" means acting before problems appear; the opposite is "reactively".

items.question: Trong câu "The BA should proactively maintain a "debt ledger":", từ "ledger" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA should proactively maintain a "debt ledger":", what does "ledger" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ledger /ˈledʒ.ər/ (danh từ): sổ cái, sổ ghi chép. "Debt ledger" = sổ theo dõi nợ; từ kế toán, ở đây dùng cho nợ kỹ thuật.
items.explanationEn: ledger /ˈledʒ.ər/ (noun): a book for recording entries. A "debt ledger" is a record of debts; an accounting term reused for technical debt.

items.question: Trong câu "Stakeholders see that trade-offs have been recorded, not forgotten", từ "stakeholder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stakeholders see that trade-offs have been recorded, not forgotten", what does "stakeholder" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person with an interest in a project
the final user of a product
items.explanation: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkˌhəʊl.dər/ (danh từ): bên liên quan (có quyền lợi). Sổ nợ kỹ thuật giúp stakeholders (bên liên quan) thấy các đánh đổi được ghi nhận.
items.explanationEn: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkˌhəʊl.dər/ (noun): a person with an interest in a project. A debt log shows stakeholders that trade-offs are being tracked.

items.question: Trong câu "Stakeholders see that trade-offs have been recorded, not forgotten", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stakeholders see that trade-offs have been recorded, not forgotten", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a balance between two opposing things
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. "Make a trade-off" = chấp nhận mất cái này để được cái kia (vd tốc độ đổi lấy chất lượng).
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (noun): a balance between two opposing things. "Make a trade-off" means giving up one thing to gain another, e.g. quality for speed.

items.question: Trong câu "Stakeholders see that trade-offs have been recorded, not forgotten", từ "record" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stakeholders see that trade-offs have been recorded, not forgotten", what does "record" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to write down for later use
items.explanation: record /rɪˈkɔːd/ (động từ): ghi lại, lưu lại. Động từ nhấn âm sau /rɪˈkɔːd/, danh từ nhấn âm đầu /ˈrek.ɔːd/; nghĩa khác: thu âm.
items.explanationEn: record /rɪˈkɔːd/ (verb): to write down for later use. The verb is stressed on the second syllable, the noun on the first; another sense is capturing sound.

items.question: Trong câu "The PO has a basis to allocate capacity for refactoring", từ "basis" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PO has a basis to allocate capacity for refactoring", what does "basis" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a reason or facts behind a decision
items.explanation: basis /ˈbeɪ.sɪs/ (danh từ): cơ sở, căn cứ. "Have a basis to/for" = có căn cứ để; cụm khác: on a daily basis (hằng ngày).
items.explanationEn: basis /ˈbeɪ.sɪs/ (noun): a reason or facts behind a decision. "Have a basis for" means having grounds for; also "on a daily basis" (every day).

items.question: Trong câu "The PO has a basis to allocate capacity for refactoring", từ "allocate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PO has a basis to allocate capacity for refactoring", what does "allocate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to give out for a purpose
items.explanation: allocate /ˈæl.ə.keɪt/ (động từ): phân bổ. "Allocate capacity/resources/memory" = phân bổ năng lực/tài nguyên/bộ nhớ; danh từ: allocation.
items.explanationEn: allocate /ˈæl.ə.keɪt/ (verb): to give out for a purpose. "Allocate capacity, resources or memory" means assigning them; the noun is "allocation".

items.question: Trong câu "The PO has a basis to allocate capacity for refactoring", từ "capacity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PO has a basis to allocate capacity for refactoring", what does "capacity" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the amount of work a team can do
items.explanation: capacity /kəˈpæs.ə.ti/ (danh từ): năng lực (khối lượng làm được). Trong sprint, "capacity" = lượng công việc team làm được; nghĩa khác: dung tích, hoặc "in my capacity as" (với vai trò).
items.explanationEn: capacity /kəˈpæs.ə.ti/ (noun): the amount of work a team can do. In a sprint, "capacity" is how much work a team can do; it also means volume, or a role ("in my capacity as").

items.question: Trong câu "The PO has a basis to allocate capacity for refactoring", từ "refactoring" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PO has a basis to allocate capacity for refactoring", what does "refactoring" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: refactoring /riːˈfæk.tər.ɪŋ/ (danh từ): việc tái cấu trúc mã. Refactoring cải thiện cấu trúc mã mà không đổi hành vi; là cách "trả nợ" kỹ thuật.
items.explanationEn: refactoring /riːˈfæk.tər.ɪŋ/ (noun): restructuring code without changing behaviour. Refactoring improves code structure without changing behaviour; it is how technical debt is repaid.

items.question: Trong câu "Devs don't feel like they "built something bad and no one knows"", từ "feel like" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Devs don't feel like they "built something bad and no one knows"", what does "feel like" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to have the same texture as
items.explanation: feel like /fiːl laɪk/ (cụm từ): cảm thấy như thể. "Feel like + mệnh đề" = cảm thấy như; "feel like + V-ing" lại là muốn làm gì (I feel like eating).
items.explanationEn: feel like /fiːl laɪk/ (phrase): to have the impression that. "Feel like + clause" means having the impression; "feel like + -ing" means wanting to do something.

items.question: Trong câu "without tracking, without a plan, without paying attention to accumulating debt", từ "accumulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "without tracking, without a plan, without paying attention to accumulating debt", what does "accumulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: accumulate /əˈkjuː.mjə.leɪt/ (động từ): tích tụ, dồn lại. "Accumulating debt" = nợ tích tụ dần; danh từ: accumulation.
items.explanationEn: accumulate /əˈkjuː.mjə.leɪt/ (verb): to gradually build up. "Accumulating debt" is debt that keeps building up; the noun is "accumulation".

items.question: Trong câu "without tracking, without a plan, without paying attention to accumulating debt", từ "pay attention to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "without tracking, without a plan, without paying attention to accumulating debt", what does "pay attention to" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to watch or think about carefully
items.explanation: pay attention to /peɪ əˈten.ʃən tuː/ (cụm từ): chú ý đến. "Pay attention to" = chú ý tới; động từ "pay" ở đây không liên quan tiền.
items.explanationEn: pay attention to /peɪ əˈten.ʃən tuː/ (phrase): to watch or think about carefully. "Pay attention to" means noticing carefully; "pay" here has nothing to do with money.

items.question: Trong câu "Not all debt is equally dangerous.", từ "equally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not all debt is equally dangerous.", what does "equally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: equally /ˈiː.kwə.li/ (trạng từ): như nhau, ngang nhau. "Not all X is equally Y" = không phải X nào cũng Y như nhau.
items.explanationEn: equally /ˈiː.kwə.li/ (adverb): to the same degree. "Not all X is equally Y" means some X are more Y than others.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA needs to learn to classify: which debt is high-risk, which is low-risk.", từ "classify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA needs to learn to classify: which debt is high-risk, which is low-risk.", what does "classify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: classify /ˈklæs.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): phân loại. "Classify" = phân loại; nghĩa khác "classified" = tài liệu mật.
items.explanationEn: classify /ˈklæs.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to sort into groups. "Classify" means sorting into groups; "classified" can also mean officially secret.

items.question: Trong câu "When a dev raises a technical concern, ask:", từ "raise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a dev raises a technical concern, ask:", what does "raise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: raise /reɪz/ (động từ): nêu ra (vấn đề). "Raise a concern/question/issue" = nêu lo ngại/câu hỏi/vấn đề; nghĩa gốc: nâng lên.
items.explanationEn: raise /reɪz/ (verb): to bring up for discussion. "Raise a concern, question or issue" means bringing it up; the basic sense is to lift.
